description_en: Queries a list of projects that meet the specified conditions. You can filter projects by project creation time
description_zh: 列出符合条件的剪辑工程，支持根据工程创建时间筛选
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-editing-projects --project-type EditingProject --template-type None --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:01Z --end-time 2022-02-02T23:59:59Z --keyword 0000006f36bc45d09a9d5cde49000000 --status Produced --create-source OpenAPI --next-token 8EqYpQbZ6Eh7+Zz8DxVYoQ== --max-results 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEditingProjects

parameters.help_en:
The type of the editing project. Valid values:

EditingProject: a regular editing project.

LiveEditingProject: a live stream editing project
parameters.help_zh:
剪辑工程类型：
EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程；
LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程
parameters.name: project_type

parameters.help_en:
The template type. This parameter is required if you create a template-based online editing project. Default value: Timeline.

-

-

Valid values:

Timeline: a regular template.

VETemplate: an advanced template.

None: general editing
parameters.help_zh: 模板类型，创建基于模板的云剪辑工程需要填写，默认值：Timeline
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. You can search by job ID
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据任务ID搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The status of the online editing project. By default, online editing projects in all states are queried

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. A maximum of 100 entries can be returned on each page.

Default value: 10

parameters.help_en:
The order of sorting of the results. Valid values:

CreationTime:Desc (default): sorts the results in reverse chronological order.

CreationTime:Asc: sorts the results in chronological order

查询结果排序。取值：

CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
